output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The condition 'require(totalSupply + _value <= TOKEN_LIMIT);' is meant to prevent overflows, but it is redundant and can be bypassed. The unprotected addition 'totalSupply += _value;' allows attackers to mint arbitrary amounts of tokens.
The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The unprotected subtraction 'totalSupply -= _value;' allows attackers to burn arbitrary amounts of tokens.

The unprotected addition 'balances[_to] += _value;' in the transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. Attackers can make the balance of a target user exceed 2^256, causing a vulnerability where attackers can steal any funds.

The unprotected addition 'balances[_to] += _value;' in the transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. Attackers can make the balance of a target user exceed 2^256, causing a vulnerability where attackers can steal any funds.

The unprotected addition 'allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value;' in the approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. Attackers can set the allowance to a very high value, allowing attackers to steal funds.
